question: In the orthogonal test of phenol removal by the alkali-fused gasification slag, what is the mean phenol removal rate of the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g?
expect: (91.95 + 95.01 + 88.94 + 82.36) / 4 = 89.57% (matches E1 of factor A in Table 3) (Table 2)
rendered:
The mean phenol removal rate of the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g can be calculated from Table 2.

The four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g are:

| number | A (g) | removal rate (%) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 0.25 | 91.95 |
| 2 | 0.25 | 95.01 |
| 3 | 0.25 | 88.94 |
| 4 | 0.25 | 82.36 |

The mean phenol removal rate is:

(91.95 + 95.01 + 88.94 + 82.36) / 4 = 90.09

So, the mean phenol removal rate of the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g is 90.09%.
